channel.title: Crypto Daybook
channel.description: Crypto Daybook reports daily crypto news: market moves, Bitcoin and Ethereum updates, exchange and protocol developments, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: WETH After a Swap: Your ETH Is Still Worth 1:1
item.description: Received WETH instead of ETH after a swap? WETH is ETH wrapped as a token and usually keeps its 1:1 value; unwrap it on Ethereum or an L2 to get native ETH.

item.title: How to Move USDC from Ethereum to Monad for Less
item.description: Cheapest way to move USDC from Ethereum to Monad: compare native USDC and permit routes, then send at a low Ethereum base fee to cut total cost.

item.title: US wins authority to seize or restrain $1.2B in Binance funds
item.description: The Justice Department won court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion tied to the Binance hack, part of $2.7 billion frozen so far.

item.title: Injective’s Veyra upgrade passes ahead of Nov. 24 activation
item.description: Injective’s Veyra upgrade passed governance, clearing a path to a Nov. 24 mainnet halt and new cross-chain and institutional trading tools for builders.

item.title: Mint Authority and Who Can Expand a Token’s Supply
item.description: What is mint authority on a token? It lets one address create supply; judge the holder’s control, program rules and upgrade authority before you buy.

item.title: How to use teleBTC on Polygon DeFi with a wallet ready
item.description: How to use teleBTC on Polygon DeFi: connect your wallet, find an app that supports it, then swap, supply to a pool or lend where available, with Polygon gas.

item.title: How to Sign a DeFi Transaction With a Hardware Wallet Safely
item.description: How to sign a DeFi transaction with a hardware wallet: connect a compatible app, compare the request with the device screen, approve each prompt, then track its hash.

item.title: USDT on TRC-20 or ERC-20? Match the DEX pair
item.description: USDT TRC-20 vs ERC-20 for DEX trading: use the chain where your token pair has a pool, then weigh TRON resources against Ethereum gas before you withdraw.

item.title: Eigen Layer Slashing: From AVS Fault to Restaker Shares
item.description: How does eigen layer slashing work? An AVS can slash only stake its operator allocated to its Operator Set, reducing delegators’ withdrawable shares proportionally.

item.title: Hardware wallet vs hot wallet for DeFi transactions: choose a safer setup
item.description: Hardware wallet vs hot wallet for DeFi transactions: hardware is safer when you verify each signature; keep savings offline and use a small hot wallet for swaps.

item.title: Bitcoin Bridge Confirmations and Minting Delays
item.description: How many Bitcoin confirmations do bridges require? Often a few to six, while value-scaled rules can make large deposits wait longer before tokens mint.

item.title: Wormhole vs Axelar for Monad Transfers: How Routes Differ
item.description: Wormhole vs Axelar for bridging to Monad: the token issuer’s framework decides the canonical route; compare received amounts and delay when several routes exist.

item.title: US wins authority over $1.2B in Binance theft funds
item.description: The Justice Department won court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of Binance’s stolen crypto, part of a wider effort to freeze the funds.

item.title: TeleSwap BTC to teleBTC transfer: follow 0.1 BTC to Polygon
item.description: A TeleSwap BTC to teleBTC transfer sends 0.1 BTC to a Locker; Bitcoin confirmations and a Merkle proof trigger the Polygon mint, minus fees.

item.title: US gets court authority over $1.2B in Binance hack
item.description: The Justice Department has court authority over more than $1.2 billion in crypto stolen from Binance, after a $6 billion hack; tracing and recovery work continue.

item.title: SyncSwap and Centralized Exchanges for a First Trade
item.description: SyncSwap vs centralized exchange for beginners: use an exchange for simpler cash purchases, or SyncSwap when you are ready to manage a funded wallet.

item.title: How to swap tokens on Fraxswap and finish the trade
item.description: How to swap tokens on Fraxswap: connect your wallet, match the network, choose tokens, set slippage, approve if needed, then confirm and check the result.

item.title: Bitcoin drops below $69,000 as market jitters deepen
item.description: Bitcoin fell to $68,408 on Friday as forced crypto selling followed a break below $70,000, while traders weighed Nvidia’s leadership shock and a possible Fed hike.

item.title: US gets authority to seize $1.2bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: US authorities won court approval to seize or restrain over $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds, part of $2.7 billion frozen since the October theft.

item.title: US gets court authority over $1.2bn in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says a court has authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion in crypto stolen from Binance, part of $2.7 billion frozen so far.
